capabilities: Render the vault as a 3D galaxy
Show global and local galaxy views
Search note names, headings, and text
Show a dashboard of activity, tasks, and stats
Highlight open tasks from note properties
extras: Requires desktop Obsidian 1.5.0+ and WebGL 2. The Linux-only desktop launcher writes a .desktop entry into ~/.local/share/applications. pywal colors need a user CSS snippet enabled; tasks are off by default. Ships a 19-second demo MP4.
problem: Obsidian's flat graph and file views make it hard to grasp the vault's structure, headings, and connections spatially.

relations.evidence: The accretion disk shader adapts plasma and column integration from second-brain-black-hole.
With Quickshell and Hyprland, a loading screen covers the start of Obsidian

summary: 3D galaxy visualizer that renders your vault as notes-as-stars, folders as clusters, and links as lines, with global and local views and search.
